title: Cholesterol Hot Spot Automated Mapping Protocol (CHAMP): Identifying Cholesterol-Binding Hot Spots in Membrane Proteins.
authors: Sotillo-Nunez, David; Nardi Cesarini, Matteo; Elisi, Gian Marco; Bernetti, Mattia; Bottegoni, Giovanni
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文开发了基于粗粒化分子动力学模拟的自动化流程CHAMP，用于识别膜蛋白-胆固醇结合热点，属于蛋白质结构相关的计算模拟方法，但聚焦于膜蛋白脂质相互作用而非核心结构预测/构象生成问题。
abstract: Biological membranes are dynamic and heterogeneous environments that actively influence protein structure and function. Cholesterol, in particular, has been widely reported to modulate membrane proteins through binding to specific interaction sites. However, the identification of these sites remains challenging due to the intrinsic complexity and dynamics of lipid bilayers, especially when multiple systems and membrane environments are considered. Here, we present CHAMP (Cholesterol hot spot automated mapping protocol), an automated Python-based workflow that combines coarse-grained molecular dynamics simulations with a dual analysis based on contact persistence and spatial density to identify cholesterol-binding hot spots at protein-membrane interfaces. The protocol requires limited user intervention and is designed to enable consistent and reproducible analyses across different targets. We validated CHAMP on the serotonin transporter and the cannabinoid receptor 1 (CB1), where it recovers known cholesterol-binding regions reported in experimental and computational studies. In the CB1 system, the method also identifies a potential additional interaction site. To assess the generality of the approach, we applied the protocol to the CB1 negative allosteric modulator Org27569, showing that it can capture relevant interaction hot spots beyond sterol molecules. Overall, CHAMP provides a practical framework for mapping interaction hot spots at protein-membrane interfaces and may support large-scale and comparative studies of membrane proteins. Limitations of the current implementation and possible extensions are discussed.
abstract_zh: 生物膜是动态且异质的环境，积极影响蛋白质的结构与功能。特别是胆固醇，已被广泛报道通过结合特定相互作用位点来调节膜蛋白。然而，由于脂质双层的固有复杂性和动态性，尤其是在考虑多个系统和膜环境时，这些位点的识别仍具挑战性。在此，我们提出CHAMP（胆固醇热点自动映射协议），一种基于Python的自动化工作流程，结合粗粒化分子动力学模拟与基于接触持续性和空间密度的双重分析，以识别蛋白质-膜界面的胆固醇结合热点。该协议需要有限的人工干预，旨在实现跨不同靶标的一致且可重复的分析。我们在血清素转运体和 cannabinoid receptor 1 (CB1) 上验证了CHAMP，它恢复了实验和计算研究中报道的已知胆固醇结合区域。在CB1系统中，该方法还识别出一个潜在的额外相互作用位点。为评估该方法的普适性，我们将该协议应用于CB1负向别构调节剂Org27569，显示其能捕获甾醇分子之外的相關相互作用热点。总体而言，CHAMP为绘制蛋白质-膜界面的相互作用热点提供了实用框架，并可能支持膜蛋白的大规模及比较研究。讨论了当前实现的局限性及可能的扩展方向。
